ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mars and Saturn

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your image. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between romance and friendships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between family and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between money and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between your image and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between your career and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
The opposition between Mars and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and money. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.
